topic.title: Swagger Support
topic.shortdesc: Documentation and examples for rendering Swagger operations as Bootstrap accordions.

body.p: DITA Bootstrap Swagger is a DITA-OT plug-in that extends the DITA Bootstrap HTML output. It renders each operation generated by fox.jason.passthrough.swagger as a collapsed Bootstrap accordion item.

fig.title: The pet operations of the Swagger Petstore, with one operation expanded

image.alt: Collapsed accordion items for each pet operation, with the GET /pet/findByStatus item expanded

section.title: Installing the DITA Bootstrap Swagger plug-in
section.p: Use the dita command to add the plug-in and its dependencies to your DITA Open Toolkit installation:
section.codeblock: dita install fox.jason.extend.css dita install org.dita-bootstrap.html dita install fox.jason.passthrough.swagger dita install org.dita-bootstrap.swagger

section.title: Using
section.p: To mark a file to be passed through for Swagger processing, label the topicref with format="swagger" within the map as shown:
The Swagger file is converted to a *.dita file and added to the build job. The title of the generated topic is the root name of the file, with any underscores replaced by spaces.
